verdict.rationale: Factory documents a Sessions API to "create and drive Droid sessions" including their messages, and the Factory App says Droid "acts on the feedback in place" when you give design-mode or inline diff comments. Together these suggest follow-up steering within an existing session. However, nothing explicitly says you can interject while the agent is actively working without restarting. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of mid-run message injection or interrupt/steer behavior during an active task, details of how follow-up messages are queued or applied, and hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send follow-up instructions to an active agent session to steer its work without restarting

citations.quote: Create and drive Droid sessions: manage their lifecycle, settings, and messages.
Droid acts on the feedback in place.
It gives the same Factory runtime through an interactive terminal UI with project context, approvals, MCP tools, Missions, and headless execution.
